title: Sitting in with the Nighthawks on a pawn-shop banjo
summary: He bought a banjo in a pawn shop and talked his way into rehearsals with the Nighthawks, his first professional work.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Yeah. So, I used to go see the Nighthawks. And the Nighthawks, now -- I went back for that purpose -- I had forgotten about them.
Yeah.

The Nighthawks -- I heard them when I went back, in other words -- I went back to bury my mother. And, then I started fooling around with the ukelele. And then I went to the pawn shop and bought me a banjo.
Oh. That's what you did. Down there?
Down there. Yeah.
I see.
Right. And then I started fooling around with that. And then I finally talked the guy with the Nighthawks to let me sit in.
Oh, you did?
Yeah. So, I sat in with them. I used to rehearse with them. I used to have rehearsal with them.
Well, that was a break, so that you would have some way of really breaking in --
Yeah, yeah.
Somewhere -- like home territory.
Right.
That was, like, really the first professional work?
Yeah. Right. Definitely. Definitely. That was the first.
So, you had to begin to know what the chords were on those numbers.
Yeah. Well, I had -- you know -- I had a book with the diagrams --
Yeah.
And -- you know how they are.
Yeah.
